statements.question: Why is there no “Pick from screen” button in Firefox, Safari or on my phone?
statements.statement: Screen picking uses the EyeDropper API, which only Chrome, Edge and Opera on desktop provide (Chrome and Edge 95+, Opera 81+; not on Linux Wayland). In other browsers the tool hides the button and makes “Open image” the main action: take a screenshot, paste it with Ctrl+V or ⌘V, and click the pixel.
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: Is the picked color the same value Photoshop or Figma shows?
statements.statement: For an untagged image or an sRGB image, yes: the tool reads the pixel as the browser draws it in sRGB. For a wide-gamut image the browser converts to sRGB first, so HEX, RGB and HSL can be clipped. In Chrome, Edge and Safari, which can create a Display P3 canvas, the tool shows a warning and keeps the real color in the OKLCH and Display P3 fields. Firefox has no P3 canvas, so it reads only the clipped sRGB value and cannot warn.
statements.qualification: The P3 warning only exists when a Display P3 canvas can be created; Firefox has no P3 canvas (MDN BCD: HTMLCanvasElement getContext options.colorSpace, Firefox false), so it reads the clipped sRGB value and cannot warn.

statements.question: Why does the HSL value have decimals?
statements.statement: HSL rounded to whole numbers usually converts back to a different color. #1a73e8 becomes hsl(214, 82%, 51%), which is #1c74e9. The tool writes the fewest decimals that convert back to the exact same HEX, so you can paste any field into CSS and get the same pixel.
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: Is my image uploaded or stored?
statements.statement: No. The image is decoded and read in a canvas in this tab; it is not uploaded and not saved. This tool saves two things in this browser's localStorage: the last 16 distinct picked HEX values and the sample size (Point, 3 × 3 or 5 × 5). Clear next to Recent colors removes the colors; Ctrl/⌘+L removes neither, and clearing this site's data in the browser removes both. The page analytics record the tool name and the action you took, such as screen_pick, image_pick or copy_hex, not the color or the image.
statements.qualification: pushRecent() deduplicates; ztPersist saves recent + sample only.

statements.question: Can it read the color of a transparent PNG pixel?
statements.statement: It shows the alpha value and writes HEX with an alpha byte, for example #1a80e60a. A canvas stores colors premultiplied by alpha, so the RGB of a nearly transparent pixel is approximate. Fully transparent pixels have no color, and the tool says so.
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.statement: **Check a brand color in a screenshot.** A product page shows a blue button. Paste the screenshot, click the button, and the tool reads `#1a73e8`. The other fields read `hsl(214.1, 81.7%, 50.6%)`, `oklch(57.4% 0.195 257.9)` and `color(display-p3 0.218 0.444 0.879)`. Each of these converts back to `#1a73e8`. Pickers that round HSL to whole numbers give `hsl(214, 82%, 51%)`, which is `#1c74e9`. The test reads every printed value back: 636,056 colors on a 3-step grid of the sRGB cube with the tool's own parser, and 30,000 random colors with [culori](https://culorijs.org/).
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: **Find the HEX for a Tailwind v4 color.** Tailwind CSS 4.3 defines `--color-blue-500: oklch(62.3% 0.214 259.815)` in its `theme.css`. Paste that value into the OKLCH field. HEX shows `#2b7fff`, and the tool warns that the color is outside sRGB. HEX, RGB and HSL can only hold sRGB, so each channel is clipped. The OKLCH field keeps the real color. The Display P3 field is computed from the clipped sRGB value, so it describes `#2b7fff`, not the original chroma.
statements.qualification: For typed oklch() input, formatColor() computes the P3 field from the clipped sRGB bytes (EyedropperColorPickerTool.astro:667-676), not from the original wide-gamut color.

statements.statement: **Pick one pixel, not a blend.** A test image of 2000 × 400 px has 1-px columns that alternate between `#ff0000` and `#0000ff`. The tool reads the image at full resolution. A point sample gives `#ff0000` or `#0000ff`, and the status line names the pixel, for example “x 1000, y 200”. The 3 × 3 average gives `rgb(85, 0, 170)`: one red column and two blue ones. Use the average on photos and gradients, where single pixels are noisy.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: **Read a transparent pixel.** In a PNG, a pixel of `#1a73e8` with alpha 10 out of 255 came back from Chromium's canvas as `rgba(26, 128, 230, 0.039)`. A canvas stores color multiplied by alpha, so a faint pixel loses precision. The tool shows the alpha in every format and adds a note instead of hiding it.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - **Screen.** The EyeDropper API returns an sRGB hex string ([MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/EyeDropper/open)). On macOS, Chromium converts the sampled display color to sRGB and then to 8 bits per channel ([`skia_utils_mac.mm`](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/main/skia/ext/skia_utils_mac.mm), `CGColorRefToSkColor`). On a wide-gamut display, a color outside sRGB comes back clipped.
statements.qualification: The linked skia_utils_mac.mm / CGColorRefToSkColor source was not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: - **Images.** The tool draws the image into an sRGB canvas and reads the pixel. CSS Color 4 says that browsers must apply an image's embedded color profile ([§3.4](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#tagged-images)) and must treat untagged images as sRGB ([§3.5](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#untagged)). Browsers that can create a Display P3 canvas (Chrome and Edge 92+, Safari 15.2+, but not Firefox, per [MDN compatibility data](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLCanvasElement/getContext)) give the tool a second readout. When that pixel is outside sRGB, the tool shows the warning and keeps the P3 value. For example, P3 red `color(display-p3 1 0 0)` is `oklch(64.86% 0.2995 28.96)`, but its HEX can only be `#ff0000`.
statements.qualification: MDN BCD: options.colorSpace Chrome 92, Safari 15.2, Firefox false.

statements.statement: - **Conversions** use the matrices and transfer functions of the [CSS Color 4 sample code](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/conversions.js). The test compares them with [colorjs.io](https://colorjs.io/) to within 10⁻⁹.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement:
| Browser | EyeDropper API |
|---|---|
| Chrome, Edge (desktop) | 95+. Not on Linux Wayland |
| Opera (desktop) | 81+ |
| Firefox, Safari, Chrome on Android, iOS browsers | No |
statements.qualification: Table checked against MDN BCD and the component.

statements.statement: Source: MDN browser-compat-data 8.1.3 (2026-09-24). Without the API, take a screenshot and paste it into the tool. On a Mac, add Control to the shortcut, for example Control-Shift-Command-4, to copy the screenshot to the clipboard instead of saving a file ([Apple](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102646)). On Windows, PrtSc puts the whole screen on the clipboard. Windows + Shift + S opens Snipping Tool, and Ctrl+C copies the snip ([Microsoft](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/use-snipping-tool-to-capture-screenshots-00246869-1843-655f-f220-97299b865f6b)). The operating system also has a screen picker: [Digital Color Meter](https://support.apple.com/guide/digital-color-meter/welcome/mac) on macOS, and on Windows [PowerToys Color Picker](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/powertoys/color-picker) (Win + Shift + C, copies HEX by default).
statements.qualification: Microsoft Snipping Tool page says PrtSc places a snapshot of the entire screen on the clipboard.

statements.statement: We tested on 2026-10-01 in a Chromium desktop browser with the same files. [htmlcolorcodes.com](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/image-color-picker/) drew the 2000 × 400 striped image into a 1536 × 307 canvas and reported `#90006F`. [imagecolorpicker.com](https://imagecolorpicker.com/) drew it at 529 × 105 and reported `#7f007f` at every point we clicked. Neither color occurs in the image. For the transparent pixel, imagecolorpicker.com showed `#1a80e6` and an `rgba()` value without an alpha. [eyedropper.online](https://eyedropper.online/) works only with the EyeDropper API. With the API removed, its button opened an alert that said to use Chrome, Edge or Opera. This tool reads image pixels at native resolution up to its 16,777,216-pixel cap, keeps the alpha and flags colors outside sRGB. When you need the contrast of two picked colors, use the [Color Contrast Checker](/tools/color-contrast-checker/). For a whole palette from one image, use the [Image Color Palette Extractor](/tools/image-color-palette/).
statements.qualification: MDN: sRGBHex is an sRGB hex string; open() requires transient user activation.

statements.statement: - Images larger than 16,777,216 pixels are scaled down before picking, because iOS limits a canvas to 4,096 × 4,096 ([MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/canvas)). The tool shows the new size.
statements.qualification: MDN says iOS limits the canvas to 4,096 × 4,096.

statements.statement: - Each screen pick needs a click. The API rejects `open()` without a user action (`NotAllowedError`), and it samples one pixel per call.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - Image formats are the ones your browser can display. HEIC opens in Safari 17 and later, not in Chrome or Firefox.
statements.qualification: Safari 17+ per caniuse HEIF; the PowerToys part of the same bullet was not re-fetched.

statements.statement: - Output formats are HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH and Display P3. CMYK, Lab and HSV are not supported.
statements.qualification: Color Converter only has HEX / RGB / HSL fields (ColorConverterTool.astro:102-128; tools.ts:32), so the former “convert the HEX in the Color Converter” advice was false and was removed.

statements.question: 为什么 Firefox、Safari 和手机上没有「从屏幕取色」按钮？
statements.statement: 屏幕取色依赖 EyeDropper API，目前只有桌面版 Chrome、Edge（95 起）和 Opera（81 起）提供，Linux Wayland 下也不可用。其他浏览器里工具会隐藏这个按钮，把「打开图片」设为主按钮：截图后按 Ctrl+V 粘贴，再点击要取的像素。
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: 截图取到的颜色和设计稿标注不一样，是工具算错了吗？
statements.statement: 先确认截图没有被缩放或压缩：聊天软件发送的图片常被压缩成 JPEG，边缘颜色会变。其次看设计稿是否用了广色域颜色。工具读取的是浏览器画到 sRGB canvas 上的像素，超出 sRGB 的颜色会被截取。Chrome、Edge、Safari 能创建 Display P3 canvas，此时工具会提示，并在 OKLCH 和 Display P3 字段保留真实颜色；Firefox 没有 P3 canvas，只读到截取后的 sRGB 值，无法提示。
statements.qualification: Same as en: the warning needs a Display P3 canvas; Firefox has none.

statements.question: HSL 为什么带小数？
statements.statement: 取整后的 HSL 大多换算不回原来的颜色。例如 WeUI 主色 #07c160 取整写成 hsl(149, 93%, 39%)，实际是 #07c060。工具会写出能换算回同一个 HEX 的最少位小数。
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: 图片会上传吗？取色记录存在哪里？
statements.statement: 不会上传。图片只在当前标签页的 canvas 里解码和读取，不上传，也不保存。本工具在本浏览器的 localStorage 里保存两项：最近 16 个不同的取色 HEX 值和取样大小（单点、3 × 3 或 5 × 5）。点「最近颜色」旁的「清空」可以删除颜色；按 Ctrl/⌘+L 两项都不会删除，清除浏览器里本站的数据可以全部删除。页面统计记录工具名和你做的操作（如 screen_pick、image_pick、copy_hex），不包含颜色值和图片。
statements.qualification: pushRecent() deduplicates; “distinct” was added.

statements.question: 透明 PNG 的像素能取色吗？
statements.statement: 能。工具会显示 alpha，并输出带透明度的 HEX，例如 #1a80e60a。canvas 按 alpha 预乘存储颜色，几乎透明的像素 RGB 只是近似值。完全透明的像素没有颜色，工具会直接说明。
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.statement: Windows 用户最常见的情况是：浏览器没问题，但要取的颜色在另一个程序里。可以按 PrtSc 把整个屏幕放进剪贴板，或者按 Windows + Shift + S 框选区域，再按 Ctrl+C 复制截图（[Microsoft 支持](https://support.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/use-snipping-tool-to-capture-screenshots-00246869-1843-655f-f220-97299b865f6b)）。回到本页按 Ctrl+V，图片就出现在工具里。Mac 上在截图快捷键里加 Control，例如 Control-Shift-Command-4，截图会存进剪贴板而不是桌面（[Apple 支持](https://support.apple.com/zh-cn/102646)）。
statements.qualification: Microsoft Snipping Tool page says PrtSc places a snapshot of the entire screen on the clipboard.

statements.statement: 微信小程序 `app.json` 的 `window.navigationBarBackgroundColor` 类型是 HexColor，文档示例写法是 `"#ff00ff"`（[微信开放文档：全局配置](https://developers.weixin.qq.com/miniprogram/dev/reference/configuration/app.html)），OKLCH 之类的写法不能用。假设设计规范要求用 WeUI 的品牌绿：WeUI 2.6.26 的样式表里 `--weui-BRAND` 是 `#07c160`。对设计稿截图取色，读到 `#07c160`，HEX 可以直接写进 `app.json`。
statements.qualification: WeChat app.json HexColor type and #ff00ff example were not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: 同一个颜色在其他字段是 `hsl(148.7, 93%, 39.2%)` 和 `oklch(71% 0.189 151.2)`。很多取色工具把 HSL 取整成 `hsl(149, 93%, 39%)`，换算回去是 `#07c060`，绿色通道差 1。本工具输出的每个字段都能换算回同一个 HEX：测试按 3 级步长遍历 sRGB 立方体（636,056 种颜色）用工具自己的解析器读回，另用 [culori](https://culorijs.org/) 读回 30,000 个随机颜色，全部一致。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: 用一张 2000 × 400 的测试图，红 `#ff0000`、蓝 `#0000ff` 两色 1 像素竖条交替。工具按原始分辨率读取，单点取样得到纯红或纯蓝，状态行写明坐标，例如「x 1000、y 200」；3 × 3 平均得到 `rgb(85, 0, 170)`，即一列红、两列蓝。照片和渐变上单个像素有噪点，用平均取样更稳。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: PNG 里一个 `#1a73e8`、alpha 为 10/255 的像素，在 Chromium 的 canvas 里读回 `rgba(26, 128, 230, 0.039)`。canvas 按 alpha 预乘存储，越透明精度越差，工具会显示 alpha 并加提示。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - **屏幕**：EyeDropper API 返回 sRGB 的十六进制字符串（[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/API/EyeDropper/open)）。在 macOS 上，Chromium 会先把取到的显示器颜色换算成 sRGB，再按每通道 8 位取整（[`skia_utils_mac.mm`](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/main/skia/ext/skia_utils_mac.mm) 的 `CGColorRefToSkColor`），广色域屏幕上超出 sRGB 的颜色会被截取。
statements.qualification: The linked skia_utils_mac.mm / CGColorRefToSkColor source was not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: - **图片**：工具把图片画进 sRGB canvas 再读像素。CSS Color 4 规定浏览器要按图片内嵌的色彩配置文件显示（[§3.4](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#tagged-images)），没有配置文件的图片按 sRGB 处理（[§3.5](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#untagged)）。支持 Display P3 canvas 的浏览器（Chrome、Edge 92 起，Safari 15.2 起，Firefox 不支持）会多读一次 P3 值，像素超出 sRGB 时，工具给出提示，并保留 P3 值。例如 `color(display-p3 1 0 0)` 的 HEX 只能写成 `#ff0000`。
statements.qualification: CSS Color 4 §3.4/§3.5 section numbers and the sRGB rule for untagged images were checked.

statements.statement: - **换算公式**取自 [CSS Color 4 示例代码](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/conversions.js)，测试与 [colorjs.io](https://colorjs.io/) 对比，误差在 10⁻⁹ 以内。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: 2026-10-01 在桌面版 Chromium 中用同一组文件实测。[StarryTool 在线取色器](https://www.starrytool.com/zh-cn/color-picker.html)同样按原图分辨率取色，也有放大镜和方向键微调。差别有两点：它的 HSL 取整，例如 `hsl(210, 80%, 50%)`；透明像素它显示 `#1A80E60A`，但不提示 RGB 是近似值。[imagecolorpicker.com](https://imagecolorpicker.com/) 把条纹测试图缩到 529 × 105 再取色，点哪里都是 `#7f007f`，原图里没有这个颜色。要比较两个取到的颜色的对比度，用[颜色对比度检测器](/zh/tools/color-contrast-checker/)；要从一张图提取整套配色，用[图像配色提取](/zh/tools/image-color-palette/)。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - 超过 16,777,216 像素的图片会先缩小再取色（iOS 的 canvas 上限是 4,096 × 4,096，[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/canvas)），工具会写明缩小后的尺寸和每个像素平均了多少原始像素。
statements.qualification: MDN says iOS limits the canvas to 4,096 × 4,096.

statements.statement: - 屏幕取色每次都要点按钮。没有用户点击时，`open()` 会以 `NotAllowedError` 拒绝；每次只取一个像素。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - 能打开的图片格式取决于浏览器，HEIC 只有 Safari 17 起能打开，Chrome 和 Firefox 不行。没有 EyeDropper API 时，也可以用 macOS 自带的[数码测色计](https://support.apple.com/zh-cn/guide/digital-color-meter/welcome/mac)，或 Windows 的 [PowerToys 取色器](https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/powertoys/color-picker)（Win + Shift + C）。
statements.qualification: Safari 17+ per caniuse HEIF; the PowerToys part of the same bullet was not re-fetched.

statements.statement: - 只输出 HEX、RGB、HSL、OKLCH、Display P3。CMYK、Lab、HSV 不在本工具的输出范围内。
statements.qualification: Color Converter only has HEX / RGB / HSL fields (ColorConverterTool.astro:102-128; tools.ts:32), so the former “convert the HEX in the Color Converter” advice was false and was removed.

statements.question: Firefox・Safari・スマートフォンで「画面から取得」が表示されないのはなぜですか？
statements.statement: 画面からの取得は EyeDropper API を使います。提供しているのはデスクトップ版の Chrome・Edge（95 以降）と Opera（81 以降）だけで、Linux の Wayland 環境でも使えません。ほかのブラウザではボタンを隠し、「画像を開く」を主ボタンにします。スクリーンショットを撮って Ctrl+V / ⌘V で貼り付け、ピクセルをクリックしてください。
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: Photoshop や Figma の値と一致しますか？
statements.statement: タグのない画像や sRGB の画像なら一致します。ツールはブラウザが sRGB で描画したピクセルを読み取るためです。広色域の画像はブラウザが sRGB に変換するので、HEX・RGB・HSL が切り詰められることがあります。Chrome・Edge・Safari は Display P3 の canvas を作れるため、その場合は注意を表示し、OKLCH と Display P3 の欄に本来の色を残します。Firefox には P3 の canvas がないので、切り詰められた sRGB 値だけを読み取り、注意は表示できません。
statements.qualification: Same as en: the warning needs a Display P3 canvas; Firefox has none.

statements.question: HSL に小数が付くのはなぜですか？
statements.statement: 整数に丸めた HSL は、多くの場合別の色に戻ります。デジタル庁デザインシステムの Blue-900（#0017c1）を hsl(233, 100%, 38%) と書くと #0017c2 になります。ツールは同じ HEX に戻る最小の桁数で書き出します。
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: 画像はアップロード・保存されますか？
statements.statement: されません。画像はこのタブの canvas でデコードして読み取り、アップロードも保存もしません。このツールがこのブラウザの localStorage に保存するのは、直近 16 件の異なる HEX とサンプルの大きさ（1 点・3 × 3・5 × 5）の 2 つです。色は「最近の色」の「クリア」で消せます。Ctrl/⌘+L ではどちらも消えず、ブラウザでこのサイトのデータを削除すると両方消えます。ページのアクセス解析は、ツール名と行った操作（screen_pick、image_pick、copy_hex など）を記録しますが、色の値や画像は含みません。
statements.qualification: pushRecent() deduplicates; “distinct” was added.

statements.question: 透過 PNG のピクセルも取得できますか？
statements.statement: できます。alpha を表示し、#1a80e60a のように透明度付きの HEX を出力します。canvas は色を alpha で乗算して保存するため、ほぼ透明なピクセルの RGB は近似値です。完全に透明なピクセルには色がないので、その旨を表示します。
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.statement: Safari と Firefox には EyeDropper API がないため、スクリーンショット経由が基本です。macOS ではショートカットに control を足すと、ファイルではなくクリップボードに保存されます（例：control + shift + command + 4、[Apple サポート](https://support.apple.com/ja-jp/102646)）。そのまま本ページで ⌘V を押せば画像が入ります。画面の色をその場で数値で見たいだけなら、macOS 付属の [Digital Color Meter](https://support.apple.com/ja-jp/guide/digital-color-meter/welcome/mac) も使えます。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: [デジタル庁デザインシステム](https://design.digital.go.jp/dads/foundations/color/)のデザイントークン（npm パッケージ [`@digital-go-jp/design-tokens`](https://github.com/digital-go-jp/design-tokens) 2.0.1）では、`--color-primitive-blue-900` が `#0017c1`、フォーカスリングに使う `--color-primitive-yellow-300` が `#ffd43d` です。このシステムで作ったサイトのボタンをスクリーンショットから取得して `#0017c1` が出れば、トークンどおりに実装されています。フォーカスインジケーターは Yellow-300 と黒の二重構造（同ページ「フォーカスカラー」）なので、ルーペで黄色の線の上に中央の枠を合わせて取得すると `rgb(255, 212, 61)` になります。
statements.qualification: DADS token values and the focus-ring description were not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: 同じ Blue-900 は HSL で `hsl(232.8, 100%, 37.8%)`、OKLCH で `oklch(38% 0.245 264.2)` です。HSL を整数にした `hsl(233, 100%, 38%)` は `#0017c2` で、青が 1 ずれます。このツールはどの欄も同じ HEX に戻る値を出します。テストでは、sRGB 立方体を 3 刻みで回した 636,056 色をツール自身のパーサーで、ランダムな 30,000 色を [culori](https://culorijs.org/) で読み戻し、すべて一致しました。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: 2000 × 400 ピクセルで、赤 `#ff0000` と青 `#0000ff` が 1 ピクセルずつ交互に並ぶテスト画像を使います。原寸の画素を読むので、1 点サンプルなら純粋な赤か青が出て、状態行に「x 1000・y 200」のように座標が出ます。3 × 3 の平均は `rgb(85, 0, 170)`（赤 1 列と青 2 列）です。写真やグラデーションでは平均のほうが安定します。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: PNG の `#1a73e8`・alpha 10/255 のピクセルは、Chromium の canvas から `#1a80e60a` として読み戻されました。透明に近いほど RGB の精度が落ちるので、ツールは alpha を表示し、注意書きを添えます。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - **画面**：EyeDropper API は sRGB の 16 進文字列を返します（[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/API/EyeDropper/open)）。macOS 版 Chromium は取得したディスプレイの色を sRGB に変換してから 8 ビットに丸めます（[`skia_utils_mac.mm`](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/main/skia/ext/skia_utils_mac.mm) の `CGColorRefToSkColor`）。広色域ディスプレイ上の sRGB 外の色は切り詰められます。
statements.qualification: The linked skia_utils_mac.mm / CGColorRefToSkColor source was not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: - **画像**：sRGB の canvas に描いて読み取ります。CSS Color 4 は、埋め込みのカラープロファイルを反映して表示すること（[§3.4](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#tagged-images)）と、プロファイルのない画像を sRGB として扱うこと（[§3.5](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#untagged)）を定めています。Display P3 の canvas を作れるブラウザ（Chrome・Edge 92 以降、Safari 15.2 以降。Firefox は非対応）では P3 でも読み取り、sRGB の外なら注意を出して P3 の値を残します。
statements.qualification: CSS Color 4 §3.4/§3.5 section numbers and the sRGB rule for untagged images were checked.

statements.statement: - **変換式**は [CSS Color 4 のサンプルコード](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/conversions.js) どおりで、テストで [colorjs.io](https://colorjs.io/) と 10⁻⁹ 以内で一致することを確認しています。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: 2026-10-01 にデスクトップ版 Chromium で同じファイルを使って確認しました。[ラッコツールズの画像カラーピッカー](https://rakko.tools/ja/tools/image-color-picker/)は原寸で読み取るため縞模様でも正しい色が出ますが、半透明ピクセルは alpha を出さず `#1A80E6` と表示します。[imagecolorpicker.com](https://imagecolorpicker.com/) は縞模様の画像を 529 × 105 に縮小して読み取り、どこをクリックしても画像にない `#7f007f` を返しました。取得した 2 色のコントラスト比は[カラーコントラストチェッカー](/ja/tools/color-contrast-checker/)で、画像全体の配色は[画像カラーパレット抽出](/ja/tools/image-color-palette/)で確認できます。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - 16,777,216 ピクセルを超える画像は縮小してから読み取ります。iOS の canvas は 4,096 × 4,096 までのためです（[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/canvas)）。縮小後のサイズと、1 ピクセルが元の何ピクセルの平均かを表示します。
statements.qualification: MDN says iOS limits the canvas to 4,096 × 4,096.

statements.statement: - 画面からの取得は毎回クリックが必要です。ユーザー操作なしの `open()` は `NotAllowedError` で拒否され、1 回で 1 ピクセルだけを取得します。
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - 開ける画像形式はブラウザ次第で、HEIC は Safari 17 以降でのみ開けます（Chrome・Firefox は非対応）。Windows なら [PowerToys のカラーピッカー](https://learn.microsoft.com/ja-jp/windows/powertoys/color-picker)（Win + Shift + C）も画面から取得できます。
statements.qualification: Safari 17+ per caniuse HEIF; the PowerToys part of the same bullet was not re-fetched.

statements.statement: - 出力は HEX・RGB・HSL・OKLCH・Display P3 です。CMYK・Lab・HSV には対応していません。
statements.qualification: Color Converter only has HEX / RGB / HSL fields (ColorConverterTool.astro:102-128; tools.ts:32), so the former “convert the HEX in the Color Converter” advice was false and was removed.

statements.question: Firefox, Safari, 휴대폰에서는 왜 "화면에서 추출" 버튼이 없나요?
statements.statement: 화면 추출은 EyeDropper API를 쓰는데, 이 API는 데스크톱 Chrome·Edge(95 이상)와 Opera(81 이상)에만 있고 Linux Wayland에서는 동작하지 않습니다. 다른 브라우저에서는 버튼을 숨기고 "이미지 열기"를 주 버튼으로 바꿉니다. 스크린샷을 찍어 Ctrl+V / ⌘V로 붙여 넣은 뒤 픽셀을 클릭하세요.
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: 포토샵이나 피그마에서 본 값과 같나요?
statements.statement: 태그가 없는 이미지나 sRGB 이미지라면 같습니다. 브라우저가 sRGB로 그린 픽셀을 읽기 때문입니다. 광색역 이미지는 브라우저가 sRGB로 변환하므로 HEX·RGB·HSL이 잘릴 수 있습니다. Chrome·Edge·Safari는 Display P3 canvas를 만들 수 있어 이때 도구가 안내를 띄우고 OKLCH와 Display P3 칸에 실제 색을 남깁니다. Firefox에는 P3 canvas가 없으므로 잘린 sRGB 값만 읽고 안내를 표시할 수 없습니다.
statements.qualification: Same as en: the warning needs a Display P3 canvas; Firefox has none.

statements.question: HSL에 소수점이 붙는 이유는 무엇인가요?
statements.statement: 정수로 반올림한 HSL은 대부분 다른 색으로 돌아갑니다. KRDS의 primary-50(#256ef4)을 hsl(219, 90%, 55%)로 쓰면 #256df4가 됩니다. 도구는 같은 HEX로 돌아가는 가장 짧은 소수 자릿수로 씁니다.
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.question: 이미지가 업로드되거나 저장되나요?
statements.statement: 아니요. 이미지는 이 탭의 canvas에서 디코딩해 읽으며, 업로드하지도 저장하지도 않습니다. 이 도구가 이 브라우저의 localStorage에 저장하는 것은 최근 서로 다른 HEX 값 16개와 샘플 크기(한 점, 3 × 3, 5 × 5) 두 가지입니다. 색은 “최근 색상” 옆의 “지우기”로 삭제할 수 있고, Ctrl/⌘+L로는 둘 다 지워지지 않으며, 브라우저에서 이 사이트의 데이터를 지우면 모두 삭제됩니다. 페이지 통계에는 도구 이름과 사용한 동작(screen_pick, image_pick, copy_hex 등)이 기록되며, 기록에는 색상 값이나 이미지가 들어가지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: pushRecent() deduplicates; “distinct” was added.

statements.question: 투명 PNG 픽셀의 색도 추출되나요?
statements.statement: 됩니다. alpha 값을 표시하고 #1a80e60a처럼 투명도가 붙은 HEX를 출력합니다. canvas는 색을 alpha로 곱해 저장하므로 거의 투명한 픽셀의 RGB는 근삿값입니다. 완전히 투명한 픽셀은 색이 없다고 알려 줍니다.
statements.qualification: FAQ answer checked against code; see correction groups.

statements.statement: 행정안전부의 [KRDS(대한민국 정부 디자인 시스템)](https://www.krds.go.kr/html/site/index.html) 디자인 토큰(npm 패키지 [`krds-uiux`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/krds-uiux) 1.1.0, `tokens/figma_token.json`)에서 light 모드 primary-50은 `#256ef4`, primary-60은 `#0b50d0`입니다. 공공기관 사이트의 주요 버튼을 캡처해 붙여 넣고 버튼 면을 클릭했을 때 `#256ef4`가 나오면 토큰대로 구현된 것입니다. 한 단계 진한 primary-60은 RGB로 `rgb(11, 80, 208)`이니, 진한 파랑 요소는 이 값과 비교합니다.
statements.qualification: KRDS 1.1.0 token values were not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: 같은 primary-50은 HSL로 `hsl(218.8, 90.4%, 55.1%)`, OKLCH로 `oklch(57.5% 0.214 261.3)`입니다. HSL을 정수로 반올림한 `hsl(219, 90%, 55%)`는 `#256df4`로, 초록 채널이 1 어긋납니다. 이 도구가 내보내는 값은 모든 칸이 같은 HEX로 되돌아갑니다. 테스트에서 sRGB 큐브를 3 간격으로 돈 636,056색을 도구 자체 파서로, 무작위 30,000색을 [culori](https://culorijs.org/)로 다시 읽어 모두 일치했습니다.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: Windows에서는 PrtSc를 누르면 전체 화면이 클립보드에 들어가고, Windows 로고 키 + Shift + S로 캡처 도구를 열어 영역을 잡은 뒤 Ctrl+C로 복사할 수 있습니다([Microsoft 지원](https://support.microsoft.com/ko-kr/windows/use-snipping-tool-to-capture-screenshots-00246869-1843-655f-f220-97299b865f6b)). 이 페이지에서 Ctrl+V를 누르면 이미지가 들어옵니다. Mac은 스크린샷 단축키에 control을 더하면(예: control-shift-command-4) 파일 대신 클립보드에 저장됩니다([Apple 지원](https://support.apple.com/ko-kr/102646)).
statements.qualification: Microsoft Snipping Tool page says PrtSc places a snapshot of the entire screen on the clipboard.

statements.statement: 빨강 `#ff0000`과 파랑 `#0000ff`가 1픽셀씩 번갈아 놓인 2000 × 400 테스트 이미지에서, 도구는 원본 해상도로 읽기 때문에 한 점 샘플로 순수한 빨강이나 파랑이 나오고 상태 줄에 "x 1000, y 200"처럼 좌표가 표시됩니다. 3 × 3 평균은 `rgb(85, 0, 170)`(빨강 1열, 파랑 2열)입니다. 사진이나 그러데이션에서는 평균 샘플이 더 안정적입니다.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: PNG에서 `#1a73e8`에 alpha 10/255인 픽셀은 Chromium의 canvas에서 `rgba(26, 128, 230, 0.039)`로 읽혔습니다. 투명할수록 RGB 정밀도가 떨어지므로 도구는 alpha를 보여 주고 안내 문구를 붙입니다.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - **화면**: EyeDropper API는 sRGB 16진 문자열을 돌려줍니다([MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/ko/docs/Web/API/EyeDropper/open)). macOS용 Chromium은 추출한 디스플레이 색을 sRGB로 변환한 뒤 채널당 8비트로 반올림합니다([`skia_utils_mac.mm`](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/main/skia/ext/skia_utils_mac.mm)의 `CGColorRefToSkColor`). 광색역 디스플레이에서 sRGB 밖의 색은 잘립니다.
statements.qualification: The linked skia_utils_mac.mm / CGColorRefToSkColor source was not re-fetched today.

statements.statement: - **이미지**: sRGB canvas에 그린 뒤 픽셀을 읽습니다. CSS Color 4는 이미지에 포함된 색상 프로필을 반영해 표시하고([§3.4](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#tagged-images)), 프로필이 없는 이미지는 sRGB로 다루라고 정합니다([§3.5](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-color-4/#untagged)). Display P3 canvas를 만들 수 있는 브라우저(Chrome·Edge 92 이상, Safari 15.2 이상, Firefox는 미지원)에서는 P3로도 읽어 sRGB 밖이면 안내를 띄우고 P3 값을 남깁니다.
statements.qualification: CSS Color 4 §3.4/§3.5 section numbers and the sRGB rule for untagged images were checked.

statements.statement: - **변환식**은 [CSS Color 4 예제 코드](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/conversions.js)를 따르고, 테스트에서 [colorjs.io](https://colorjs.io/)와 10⁻⁹ 이내로 일치함을 확인합니다.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: 2026-10-01 데스크톱 Chromium에서 같은 파일로 확인했습니다. [Pixel Color Pick](https://pixelcolorpick.co.kr/)은 원본 해상도로 읽어 줄무늬에서도 정확한 색이 나오지만, 반투명 픽셀은 alpha 없이 `#1A80E6`으로 표시합니다. EyeDropper API를 없앤 상태에서는 "화면에서 추출" 버튼이 설명 없이 비활성화됐습니다. [imagecolorpicker.com](https://imagecolorpicker.com/)은 줄무늬 이미지를 529 × 105로 줄여 읽어, 어디를 클릭해도 이미지에 없는 `#7f007f`를 돌려줬습니다. 추출한 두 색의 대비는 [색상 명도 대비 검사기](/ko/tools/color-contrast-checker/)로, 이미지 전체 배색은 [이미지 컬러 팔레트 추출기](/ko/tools/image-color-palette/)로 확인하세요.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - 16,777,216픽셀을 넘는 이미지는 줄인 뒤 읽습니다. iOS의 canvas 상한이 4,096 × 4,096이기 때문입니다([MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/ko/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/canvas)). 줄인 크기와 1픽셀이 원본 몇 픽셀의 평균인지 표시합니다.
statements.qualification: MDN says iOS limits the canvas to 4,096 × 4,096.

statements.statement: - 화면 추출은 매번 클릭이 필요합니다. 사용자 동작 없이 호출한 `open()`은 `NotAllowedError`로 거부되며, 한 번에 1픽셀만 추출합니다.
statements.qualification: Checked against code / sources.

statements.statement: - 열 수 있는 이미지 형식은 브라우저에 따라 다르며, HEIC는 Safari 17 이상에서만 열립니다(Chrome·Firefox 미지원). Mac의 [디지털 컬러 측정기](https://support.apple.com/ko-kr/guide/digital-color-meter/welcome/mac), Windows의 [PowerToys 색 선택기](https://learn.microsoft.com/ko-kr/windows/powertoys/color-picker)(Win + Shift + C)로도 화면 색을 볼 수 있습니다.
statements.qualification: Safari 17+ per caniuse HEIF; the PowerToys part of the same bullet was not re-fetched.

statements.statement: - 출력 형식은 HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, Display P3입니다. CMYK·Lab·HSV는 지원하지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: Color Converter only has HEX / RGB / HSL fields (ColorConverterTool.astro:102-128; tools.ts:32), so the former “convert the HEX in the Color Converter” advice was false and was removed.

statements.statement: Open or drop an image, or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V / ⌘V. Formats depend on browser support. Images above 16,777,216 pixels are scaled before sampling; the image note shows the working size.

variants.en: Open or drop an image, or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V / ⌘V. Formats depend on browser support. Images above 16,777,216 pixels are scaled before sampling; the image note shows the working size.
variants.zh: 打开或拖入图片，也可按 Ctrl+V / ⌘V 粘贴截图。可读格式取决于浏览器。超过 16,777,216 像素的图片先缩小再取样，图片旁会显示处理尺寸。
variants.ja: 画像を開く・ドロップするか、Ctrl+V / ⌘V でスクリーンショットを貼り付けます。対応形式はブラウザ次第です。16,777,216 ピクセルを超える画像は縮小して取得し、処理サイズを画像の横に表示します。
variants.ko: 이미지를 열거나 끌어 놓거나 Ctrl+V / ⌘V로 스크린샷을 붙여 넣으세요. 지원 형식은 브라우저에 따라 다릅니다. 16,777,216픽셀을 넘으면 축소한 뒤 추출하며, 이미지 옆에 처리 크기를 표시합니다.

statements.qualification: Visible copy; all four languages checked.

statements.statement: Choose one pixel or a 3 × 3 or 5 × 5 average. Sampling uses the image pixels, independent of the displayed zoom. Near an edge, only available pixels are included.

variants.en: Choose one pixel or a 3 × 3 or 5 × 5 average. Sampling uses the image pixels, independent of the displayed zoom. Near an edge, only available pixels are included.
variants.zh: 选择单像素、3 × 3 或 5 × 5 平均。取样使用图片像素，不受显示缩放影响。靠近边缘时只计入图内的像素。
variants.ja: 1 点、3 × 3、5 × 5 の平均から選びます。表示倍率に関係なく画像のピクセルを使います。画像の端では範囲内のピクセルだけを平均します。
variants.ko: 한 점, 3 × 3 또는 5 × 5 평균을 선택하세요. 표시 배율과 관계없이 이미지 픽셀을 사용합니다. 가장자리에서는 이미지 안의 픽셀만 평균에 포함합니다.

statements.qualification: Visible copy; all four languages checked.

statements.statement: Type or paste HEX, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), color(display-p3 …), or a CSS color name into any field. The other formats update for each valid color and keep its transparency. While the value is not a color, the other fields are emptied, Copy is off and the status line says what is wrong.

variants.en: Type or paste HEX, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), color(display-p3 …), or a CSS color name into any field. The other formats update for each valid color and keep its transparency. While the value is not a color, the other fields are emptied, Copy is off and the status line says what is wrong.
variants.zh: 任何字段都可输入或粘贴 HEX、rgb()、hsl()、oklch()、color(display-p3 …) 或 CSS 颜色名。识别出有效颜色时，其他格式同步更新，透明度保留。值不是颜色时，其他字段清空、复制停用，状态行说明哪里不对。
variants.ja: どの欄にも HEX、rgb()、hsl()、oklch()、color(display-p3 …)、CSS の色名を入力・貼り付けできます。有効な色を読み取るとほかの形式も更新し、透明度を保ちます。色として読めない間はほかの欄を空にしてコピーを止め、どこが違うかを状態行に表示します。
variants.ko: 어느 칸에든 HEX, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), color(display-p3 …) 또는 CSS 색 이름을 입력하거나 붙여 넣으세요. 유효한 색을 읽으면 다른 형식이 갱신되며 투명도를 유지합니다. 색으로 읽을 수 없는 동안에는 다른 칸을 비우고 복사를 끄며, 무엇이 틀렸는지 상태 줄에 표시합니다.

statements.qualification: Visible copy; all four languages checked.

statements.statement: The most recent 16 distinct HEX colors are kept. Click a swatch to apply it again. Clear beside this list removes saved colors; typed input alone does not add a color.

foundProblems.problem: MAX_CANVAS_AREA caps only the total area at 16,777,216. A 5000 x 3000 image (15,000,000 px) is not scaled but exceeds the 4,096 px side limit MDN gives for iOS; an extreme image above the area cap can also scale to a side above 4,096 (20,000 x 1,000 -> about 18,260 x 913). On iOS the canvas may be unusable, which contradicts the Limits rationale.
foundProblems.impact: iOS users with panoramas or wide screenshots may get no color. Not reproduced on iOS hardware; derived from MDN and the code path.
foundProblems.suggestion: Scale until both w <= 4096 and h <= 4096 as well as area <= 16,777,216; add a regression with fitImageSize(5000, 3000, MAX_CANVAS_AREA).
